title: Vulnerability digest — 20 Nov 2026, 18:12 CET
markdown:
* **CVE-2026-40217**, BerriAI LiteLLM, It contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.
  [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-40217), [GitHub Advisory](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/security/advisories/GHSA-wxxx-gvqv-xp7p), [CISA Directive](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
* **CVE-2026-90817**, Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap), It contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server via crafted HTTP requests.
  [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-90817), [REDCap Community](https://projectredcap.org/resources/community), [CISA Directive](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
* **CVE-2024-10441**, Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM), It contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.
  [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-10441), [Synology Advisory](https://www.synology.com/zh-tw/security/advisory/Synology_SA_24_20), [CISA Directive](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
* **CVE-2026-90436**, Apache Axis, It contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message; users are advised to discontinue use or transition to a supported version as the product may be end-of-life.
  [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-90436), [Apache Mailing List](https://lists.apache.org/thread/8slf0j9gz35z56t0glt5h0ncwlbn4bdz), [CISA Directive](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
* **CVE-2026-80188**, BuddyBoss BuddyBoss Addons, The BuddyBoss Addons plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in versions up to, and including, 1.2.1 due to trusting unverified Apple and Facebook identity-token claims. Fix: Update to version 1.2.2 or later.
  [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-80188), [BuddyBoss Release](https://buddyboss.com/resources/buddyboss-addons/addons-1-2-2/), [Wordfence Threat Intelligence](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/9cb4a3f2-af99-473d-b70e-1ea1afca23ff?source=cve)
* **CVE-2026-125094**, optimole Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization, The Optimole plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.19 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
  [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-125094), [Plugin Trac Admin](https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/browser/optimole-wp/tags/4.2.19/inc/admin.php#L520), [Plugin Trac Manager](https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/browser/optimole-wp/tags/4.2.19/inc/manager.php#L593)
* **CVE-2026-131804**, seraphinitesoft Seraphinite Accelerator, The Seraphinite Accelerator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.31 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
  [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-131804), [Plugin Trac Gen](https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/browser/seraphinite-accelerator/tags/2.31/Cmn/Gen.php#L1704), [Plugin Trac UI](https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/browser/seraphinite-accelerator/tags/2.31/Cmn/Ui.php#L593)
